title: Mixers, IF and image response
idea: A mixer puts out the sum and difference of its two inputs. That tunes receivers, makes SSB and turns it back into audio.

rows: Sum and difference; the IF filter keeps one

compare.how: Mixing two RF signals to get their sum and difference.
The one fixed frequency the receiver's filters work at. Tuning the LO brings each station to it.
A signal twice the IF away from the one you want. It mixes to the IF too.

traps.why: You can't change the station's frequency. You tune the local oscillator.
Mixers add and subtract frequencies: sum and difference.
The oscillator feeds the modulator. Picking one sideband is a filter's job.

traps.wrong: Used in an FM receiver to filter out unwanted sidebands
traps.why: Product detectors are for single sideband: they recover the audio.
